```{python}
#| label: fig-semicustom-flow
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "High-level semicustom design flow: from design capture in an HDL through logic synthesis, floorplanning, placement, and routing to tapeout. Pre- and post-layout simulations verify the design; failed checks lead to design iterations back to earlier steps."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch


def box(ax, x, y, text, w=3.0, h=0.8, rounded=False, fc='#e8eef4'):
    if rounded:
        # shrink by the pad so the padded outer edge matches w x h exactly
        p = 0.08
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x - w / 2 + p, y - h / 2 + p),
                                    w - 2 * p, h - 2 * p,
                                    boxstyle=f'round,pad={p}',
                                    fc='#f4e8d8', ec='k', lw=1.0))
    else:
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x - w / 2, y - h / 2), w, h, fc=fc,
                               ec='k', lw=1.0))
    ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9)


def arr(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle='->',
                                 mutation_scale=12, lw=1.0,
                                 shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 6.8))

main = [('Design capture', True), ('HDL', False),
        ('Logic synthesis', False), ('Floorplanning', False),
        ('Placement', False), ('Routing', False), ('Tapeout', True)]
ys = [9.6, 8.4, 7.2, 6.0, 4.8, 3.6, 2.4]
for (text, rounded), y in zip(main, ys):
    box(ax, 5.0, y, text, rounded=rounded)
for y0, y1 in zip(ys[:-1], ys[1:]):
    arr(ax, 5.0, y0 - 0.4, 5.0, y1 + 0.4)

# side boxes
box(ax, 0.9, 7.8, 'Pre-layout\nsimulation', w=2.4, h=1.0)
box(ax, 0.9, 5.4, 'Post-layout\nsimulation', w=2.4, h=1.0)
box(ax, 0.9, 3.6, 'Circuit\nextraction', w=2.4, h=1.0)

arr(ax, 3.5, 7.2, 2.1, 7.6)      # synthesis -> pre-layout sim
arr(ax, 2.1, 8.0, 3.5, 8.4)      # pre-layout sim -> HDL
arr(ax, 3.5, 3.6, 2.1, 3.6)      # routing -> extraction
arr(ax, 0.9, 4.1, 0.9, 4.9)      # extraction -> post-layout sim
arr(ax, 2.1, 5.6, 3.5, 6.0)      # post-layout sim -> floorplanning
arr(ax, 2.1, 5.2, 3.5, 4.8)      # post-layout sim -> placement

# iteration loop: post-layout simulation back to the top (dashed)
ax.plot([-0.3, -0.6, -0.6], [5.4, 5.4, 9.6], 'k--', lw=1.0)
ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((-0.6, 9.6), (3.5, 9.6), arrowstyle='->',
                             mutation_scale=12, lw=1.0, linestyle='--'))
ax.text(1.4, 9.75, 'design iteration', fontsize=8, ha='center')

ax.set_xlim(-0.9, 9.2)
ax.set_ylim(1.8, 10.2)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
